QuestInfo.name: A New Name
QuestInfo.0: Looks like you're stuck here for now. Doesn't seem so bad, especially with all the soul-searching you need to do. Talk to Silver, the Chief Fox.
QuestInfo.1:
Silver seemed to think you forgot your name, so he tried to give you a new, terrible one. Luckily Moonbeam jumped in and gave you the name #r#eShade#n#k. It's better than Silver's suggestion, anyway.

Now is a good time to take a look around the house that you'll be staying at.
QuestInfo.2: You got a new name, Shade, the compliment to Moonbeam. Time to get used to life in the village.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 500
Can proceed to Welcome to the Neighborhood

yes.0: Follow the path to the right and you'll see a house with a large pot. That's the one. Make yourself at home, my tasty friend.

no.0: No, no, it's no problem at all. The owner of the house has been gone for years. Just as well that someone get some use out of it.

1.0: So, did you take a look around the house? It's kind of small, but it's fit for one fox. And you, hopefully.

default.0: We're a very small, tight-knit community, so we don't lock our doors. We share all our hunts anyway.
